description: Retrieves reviews for albums with extensive filtering options. Returns fields such as the number of agreements (agreecnt), the user-assigned score, the review text, and title. Note that the `callback` parameter only works with JSON format on GET requests, the `limit` is capped at 200 rows, and using `fullcount` can impact performance.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Wraps JSON response in a callback function (JSONP). Only works with JSON format on GET requests.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The position to start returning results from.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default 10, max 200. The keyword 'all' is limited to 200 rows.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort results by the queried field(s). Append _asc or _desc to set direction; ascending is default.

parameters.name: fullcount
parameters.description: If true, response header includes 'results_fullcount' with the total number of rows ignoring limit/offset.

parameters.name: datebetween
parameters.description: Filter reviews released between two dates. Format: yyyy-mm-dd_yyyy-mm-dd.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: One or more user IDs (no access token required).

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: OAuth2 access token for the Jamendo user.

parameters.name: hasscore
parameters.description: Filter reviews that have (or don't have) a score.

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request, including status, code, and results_count.

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of review objects, each containing fields such as id, title, text, score, agreecnt, etc.

notes: `callback` only works when format=json or jsonpretty and the request method is GET.
`limit` cannot exceed 200 rows, even when using the keyword 'all'.
Enabling `fullcount` may impact performance on large result sets.
